title: Rav Ada son of Rav Chinena or Chanina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Nedarim 22b, in an aggadic matter; Hyman reports that in Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20 he is mentioned as Rav Ada bar Chanina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Nedarim 22b writes Rav Ada beRabbi Chanina. The matching connected paragraph of Midrash Rabbah — TE, Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20, writes Rabbi Ada bar Rabbi Chanina. Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav before the father’s name; these title and patronymic-form differences are retained. The Bamidbar comparison supports the expansion of במ״ד here, without claiming inspection of printed pages.

The whole Davidson Nedarim 22b paragraph writes Rav Ada beRabbi Chanina, while the complete 29,335-character Midrash Rabbah TE Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20 scalar writes Rabbi Ada bar Rabbi Chanina. Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav before his father’s name and retains Chinena-or-Chanina. These title and patronymic forms remain distinct; the current mixed note is verbatim. The source’s במ״ד expansion is locally supported without printed collation, identity harmonization, or importation of the long paragraph’s other material.
